title: GRADE-RTL: Evaluating LLM-Generated RTL Beyond Compilation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) code from natural-language specifications, but compilation alone does not establish structural completeness, functional correctness, or implementation efficiency. This paper presents a framework for evaluating LLM-generated RTL beyond compilation, which we named GRADE-RTL. Using fixed prompts and validation settings, GRADE-RTL applies five checks, such as Port Signature, Compilation, Elaboration, Module Completeness, and Fun
